ui.description1: Standard risk analysis data for processes involving high-pressure gas
ui.description2: and toxic chemicals. Please check the detailed images.

list.title: Shell & Tube Heat Exchanger Inspection & High-Pressure Water Jet Cleaning
list.hazard: Tissue penetration by high-pressure water, chemical burns from residual fluids
list.measure: Wear specialised protective suits, fully open drain valves, and follow LOTO procedures

list.title: High-Pressure Hydrogen Compressor Packing Replacement
list.hazard: Explosion due to hydrogen leakage, asphyxiation due to nitrogen purging
list.measure: Verify 0% hydrogen with portable gas detectors, wear anti-static clothing, and use non-sparking tools

list.title: Toxic Chemical Piping Valve & Gasket Replacement
list.hazard: Splashing of residual liquids during flange disassembly, toxic gas poisoning
list.measure: Wear full-face gas masks, loosen bolts sequentially away from the body

list.title: Flare Stack Tip Replacement & Ignition System Maintenance
list.hazard: Falls due to high winds, fire exposure if residual gas ignites
list.measure: Monitor wind speed (prohibited above 10m/s), use double-lanyard safety harnesses, and verify DCS isolation

list.title: Function Check of Emergency Response Equipment
list.hazard: Impact from hose detachment during high-pressure water discharge, gas inhalation
list.measure: Verify hose safety pin engagement, work with back to the wind, and use dedicated caps

list.title: PSA Adsorption Tower Lower Automatic Valve Inspection
list.hazard: Crushing due to unexpected valve operation, respiratory issues from adsorbent dust
list.measure: Remove residual pneumatic pressure, implement LOTO, and wear high-efficiency dust masks

list.title: Internal Visual Inspection & NDT of High-Pressure Hydrogen Storage Tanks
list.hazard: Asphyxiation in confined space, explosion caused by lighting leakage
list.measure: Measure gas concentration at top/middle/bottom, use forced ventilation and explosion-proof low-voltage (under 24V) lighting

list.title: High-Pressure Hydrogen Tanker Unloading & Charging Bay Connection
list.hazard: Crushing due to vehicle rolling, hydrogen gas explosion due to static discharge
list.measure: Install 2 or more wheel chocks, connect grounding clamps first, and verify resistance

list.title: DCS/PLC Panel Inspection & Field Transmitter Calibration
list.hazard: Unexpected process shutdown due to interlock failure, electric shock from live parts
list.measure: Double-check DCS bypass status, verify use of insulated gloves and anti-static clothing

list.title: Cooling Water System Biocide & Corrosion Inhibitor Chemical Replenishment
list.hazard: Gas explosion if different chemicals mix, chemical eruption when opening containers
list.measure: Double-check chemical labels, store separately, and relieve internal pressure while wearing face protection
